lines.zh: 蹄子踏过草叶，火星落在后面。
lines.en: My hooves crush the grass and leave sparks behind.

lines.zh: 我沿着田埂走，翅膀半张着。
lines.en: I pace the field edge with my wings half open.

lines.zh: 轻步穿过麦地，不踩倒一根。
lines.en: I step through the wheat without bending a stalk.

lines.zh: 羽毛扫过空气，像炭火呼吸。
lines.en: My feathers sweep the air like breathing coals.

lines.zh: 绕着村口走一圈，再飞起来。
lines.en: I circle the village gate once, then lift off.

lines.zh: 爪子收起，落地几乎没有声音。
lines.en: Claws tucked, I land almost without a sound.

lines.zh: 我在屋顶之间低飞，避开烟囱。
lines.en: I skim between rooftops and dodge the chimneys.
A warm glow trails from my tail feathers.

lines.zh: 走过石路，热气从脚下升起。
lines.en: Heat rises from the stones beneath my claws.

lines.zh: 风推着我，我便顺势滑翔。
lines.en: The wind pushes me and I glide along with it.

lines.zh: 我去看看那片新长的嫩草。
lines.en: I am off to check the fresh green shoots.

lines.zh: 翅膀一压，我绕过整片树丛。
lines.en: One wingbeat and I clear the whole thicket.
I preen the bright feathers on my chest.
The sun makes me drowsy and slow.
I stare at a thin thread of cooking smoke.

lines.zh: 我喉间滚出细碎的咕噜。
lines.en: A fine trilling hum rises from my throat.
I tuck my beak under a wing for warmth.
I count the people passing the village gate.

lines.zh: 我要等风把热气托起来。
lines.en: I wait for wind to lift my warmth.

lines.zh: 身上的热气把草尖烘干了。
lines.en: My body heat dries the tips of the grass.

lines.zh: 偶尔啄一下脚边的石子。
lines.en: Now and then I peck a pebble by my feet.
Eyes closed, I listen to the leaves.
My plumage darkens as the daylight shifts.
I turn my head slowly toward the shade.
No one is near, so I rest here.
A shiver sends red flecks flying off.

lines.zh: 我把一只脚缩起来，只站一只。
lines.en: I tuck one foot up and stand on the other.

lines.zh: 屋脊上的瓦被我烤得发烫。
lines.en: The tiles of this roof grow hot under me.

lines.zh: 金苹果的甜味还留在嘴里。
lines.en: The sweetness of the golden apple still lingers.

lines.zh: 我抖抖尾羽，落下一小片火星。
lines.en: I shake my tail and a few sparks fall.

lines.zh: 你身上有金苹果的味道吗？
lines.en: Do you happen to carry golden apples?
I tilt my head at you, eyes bright.

lines.zh: 你走得慢，我就多看你一会儿。
lines.en: You walk slowly, so I keep watching.

lines.zh: 陌生人，你也是来看村子的？
lines.en: Stranger, are you here for the village too?

lines.zh: 你的脚步，我已经听熟了。
lines.en: I have learned the sound of your walk.
Do not reach quickly, or I will step back.

lines.zh: 你抬头，我正停在你檐上。
lines.en: You look up; I am perched on your roof.

lines.zh: 你手里那玩意儿，我看了半天。
lines.en: I keep studying whatever is in your hand.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛映出我的火光。
lines.en: Your eyes reflect the glow of my wings.

lines.zh: 我轻轻叫了一声，算是招呼。
lines.en: I give one soft call as a greeting.

lines.zh: 你靠近时我不躲，只是看着。
lines.en: I do not flee when you near; I watch.

lines.zh: 这个村子里，我记住你了。
lines.en: In this village, I will remember you.
A small tuft at my wing base is burned.
I retreat under the eaves to breathe.
My wing hangs low; I cannot fly.
My chest took a blow and feels tight.
My cry is ugly; do not listen.
I cannot stand straight; steady me.
My heat is fading and I feel cold.
There is a gash across my leg.
Do not let it get near me again.
I am still standing, only it hurts.

lines.zh: 金苹果，我就为这个留下。
lines.en: A golden apple; that is why I stay.

lines.zh: 甜味一飘过来，我就迈步。
lines.en: One whiff of sweetness and I walk over.
Is that for me? I will wait.

lines.zh: 我低头去够你掌心的果子。
lines.en: I lower my head to your palm.

lines.zh: 金光一闪，我眼睛都直了。
lines.en: One glint of gold and I am fixed.
Do not tease me; I mean it.
I smell fruit ripened in the sun.

lines.zh: 咬一口甜果，我就随你去。
lines.en: One bite of sweet fruit and I come along.
I stretch my neck out, quite shamelessly.
This beats wild grass by a mile.

lines.zh: 小心，我身上还带着热气。
lines.en: Careful, there is still heat on me.

lines.zh: 你撞到我翅膀了，让一让。
lines.en: You bumped my wing; give me room.
Do not shove me; I am no chicken.
I stumble twice and my feathers flare.
That close, you might get singed.
Steady yourself; I weigh far more than you.

lines.zh: 翅膀收不回去，先退一步。
lines.en: I cannot fold my wings; step back first.
You just stepped on my claw.

lines.zh: 我拍了下翅膀表示不满。
lines.en: I flap once to show my annoyance.

lines.zh: 路这么宽，别非走我这边。
lines.en: The road is wide; do not walk into me.
I groom your crest with my beak.
Come, share half of my warmth.
Let us circle the village edge together.
I call softly, only for you.

lines.zh: 两只火鸟的影子落在田里。
lines.en: Two firebird shadows fall across the field.
You lead the wind; I follow after.

lines.zh: 这个巢够大，能塞下我们。
lines.en: This nest is big enough for us both.

lines.zh: 我衔来一根最亮的羽毛。
lines.en: I bring you my brightest feather.
Standing side by side, we are warm.
Listen; my voice is trembling.
This one goes in my saddlebag.
Nine slots, and a few still empty.
I will carry it without crushing it.
Hand it here; I can bear the weight.
Let me keep the small things safe.
I clamp it tight against my wing base.
Who is this meant to be delivered to?
My beak holds it steady; do not worry.
The bag grows heavy and so do my steps.
I remember which pocket it went in.

lines.zh: 有东西靠近你，我看见了。
lines.en: Something is stalking you, and I see it.
I spread my wings and stand in front.
That shadow is not what it seems.
I am guarding you; do not back away.
One more step from it and I move.
The fire in my throat is kindling.
There are footsteps behind you.

lines.zh: 我盯住那团暗色的东西。
lines.en: I fix my eyes on that dark shape.

lines.zh: 这村子归我照看，包括你。
lines.en: This village is mine to watch, you included.

lines.zh: 我伏低，把力气收到后腿。
lines.en: I drop low and gather force in my legs.

lines.zh: 它手里拿着东西，很危险。
lines.en: It is holding something dangerous.
I stay silent and study it first.
I circle to its flank; the wind helps.
I mark every breath it takes.

lines.zh: 它再挪半步，我就够得着。
lines.en: Half a step more and it is within reach.
Wings wide, my shadow covers it.
I wait for it to show a gap.

lines.zh: 热气在我羽毛下聚起来。
lines.en: Heat gathers beneath my feathers.

lines.zh: 它看向别处了，就是现在。
lines.en: It looked away; this is the moment.
I keep my call low so it stays unaware.
My claws have dug into the ground.
It is shorter than you; I come from above.
I creep forward, one inch at a time.
The wind shifted, so I change my angle.
My claws land first, the fire follows.
One wingbeat and it stumbles back.
I peck its hand until it drops the weapon.
That blow was for the village.

lines.zh: 我撞上去，把火压进它胸口。
lines.en: I slam into it, pressing fire to its chest.
It cannot get a grip on my feathers.
I leap and kick out with both claws.
Sparks spray across its face.
It flees; I chase only to the field edge.
Stay behind me and keep your hands back.

lines.zh: 我从云里落下来，羽毛发亮。
lines.en: I drop out of the clouds, feathers glowing.

lines.zh: 这个村子难得有我这样的客人。
lines.en: This village rarely gets a guest like me.
The heat arrives before I touch down.

lines.zh: 我落在田边，惊起一群麻雀。
lines.en: I land by the field and flush the sparrows.

lines.zh: 有人住的地方，我才愿意停。
lines.en: I only stop where people have settled.

lines.zh: 翅膀一收，四周安静下来。
lines.en: My wings fold and the air goes quiet.
I come rarely, so do not blink.

lines.zh: 烟囱的味道把我引来了。
lines.en: The smell of chimneys drew me here.

lines.zh: 我在屋脊上站定，看看四周。
lines.en: I settle on the ridge and look around.

lines.zh: 草叶被我的热烤得卷起。
lines.en: The grass curls under my warmth.

lines.zh: 走过路过的人，抬头看我。
lines.en: Whoever passes looks up at me.
I shake off the dust of the road.
My feathers are singed; I hate fire.

lines.zh: 摔下来的时候翅膀没撑住。
lines.en: My wings failed me when I fell.
Soaked through, I cannot lift off.

lines.zh: 炸过之后，我半天听不见。
lines.en: After the blast I hear nothing for a while.
An arrow went through my feathers.
That strange smell makes my head swim.
There is too little grass; I am thin.

lines.zh: 雷劈在附近，我毛都竖了。
lines.en: Lightning struck close and my feathers rose.

lines.zh: 下面是空的，我抓不住风。
lines.en: Below is nothing; the wind will not hold me.
